title: Sean Payton: Reverse that led to Jaylen Waddle injury was an "awful" play call

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton: Reverse that led to Jaylen Waddle injury was an "awful" play call
sources.description: Broncos wide receiver Jaylen Waddle left Sunday's game against the Cardinals after suffering a chest injury on a fourth quarter play that head coach Sean Payton would like to have back.
